name: v2.28.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Add Python 3.15 trove classifier by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2301
* Refactor: move Polars files to a package directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2302
* Move many utility files to a `utils` directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2303
* Move various completion files to a `completion` directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2304
* Move `fzf.py` inside a package directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2305
* Move `hybrid_redirection.py` inside a package directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2306
* Move `sql_result.py` inside a package directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2307
* Rename `special` package to `special_commands` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2308
* Move integrations to an `integrations/` directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2309
* Move `prompt_toolkit` extensions to `ptoolkit` directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2310
* Move `mycli_lexer.py` to a `pygments/` package directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2311
* Move `password_sources.py` to a `credentials/` package directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2312
* Create an `execution/` package directory by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2313
* Add `.txt` to text files without file extensions by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2314
* Move `test` directory to `mycli_test` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2315
* Ignore recent refactor move commits in git-blame by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2316
* Rename `polars` package to `dataframe` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2317
* Rename the `ptoolkit` package to `prompt_toolkit` for clarity by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2318
* Move `fzf` package under `integrations/` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2319
* Rename `hybrid_redirection` package to `redirection` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2320
* Ignore more file moves in git-blame by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2321
* Recast `cli_is_multiline()` as `repl_is_multiline()` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2322
* Align some imports and variable names to match filename moves by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2323
* Recast `sqlexecute` as `sql_execute` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2324
* Recast `QueryRunner` as `BackgroundRunner` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2325
* Fix spelling error in package name by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2326
* Recast "ptoolkit" as "prompt_toolkit" in more places by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2327
* Align one-line app descriptions with `README.md` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2328
* Prepare changelog for release v2.28.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2329


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.28.0...v2.28.1
